name: Balatro-TS-TW
title: Balatro Shader
description: A full-screen animated shader that churns deep blue and crimson into a marbled, liquid-like pattern with pale highlights, slowly rotating and drifting as it runs.
use: You want a bold animated backdrop that fills a hero or section and needs no images, just colour and motion.
avoid: It is a heavy WebGL canvas that never idles, and its dark vibrant colours may fight a light page.
a11y: A continuously running shader that ignores reduced-motion, with no way to pause it, and it needs a sized parent to fill. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The whole area fills with a swirling, marbled pattern of deep navy blue and blood red, shot through with thin pale-blue and white streaks and glossy highlights. Dark near-black pools sit between glossy colour bands, giving the look of oil paint or polished stone in motion.
behaves: The pattern rotates and churns continuously, its eddies drifting and re-forming as it runs. Moving the pointer nudges the swirl slightly, and colours, speed and contrast can be changed.
customise: Three hex colours, spin rotation and speed, offset, contrast, lighting, spin amount, pixel filter, spin ease, a rotation toggle and mouse interaction are props. Nothing else changes without editing.
weight: heavy: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader runs a five-iteration loop on every frame.
issues: The shader never pauses and ignores reduced-motion, which can bother motion-sensitive users.
It needs a sized parent; as a bare canvas with h-full it collapses to zero height.
polishWhy: Rich marbled motion with strong colour contrast; it is heavy and never rests.
